notes.title: We’re not on vacation, we’re at Gamescom (well, almost)!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We know we’ve been a little quiet lately… but we promise: we’re [i]not[/i] on holiday 🌴 we’re knee-deep in preparations for [b]Gamescom 2025[/b], where we’ll be showcasing [b]Movierooms[/b] at our very own booth! 🎉[/p][p]🎮 Setting up a stand from scratch at one of the biggest international events is a real [i]management mission,[/i] fitting, right? That’s exactly what our game is all about! 😄[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/9e38067483c206c948a9b0d40f507daa622dedd9.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Here's what we’re dealing with behind the scenes:[/b][/h3][p]✅ Designing a full 12 m² booth (purchased space + full setup) with a demo station, custom graphics and promotional materials
✅ Producing a [b]foldable wall banner[/b] using sublimated nautical fabric, light enough to fit in our suitcase (!)
✅ Hunting down [b]collapsible chairs and gear[/b] we can travel with (yep, renting everything is just too expensive 😅)
✅ Planning meals & staying sane with our self-made lunch/dinner kits during the intense show days
✅ Finding [b]free parties & events[/b] where we can network (even when we’re dead tired🥴) ✅ Space optimisation: from the table and PC layout to the logistics of hanging the tent without ruining the panels (and thus avoiding any fines). [/p][p]✅ Organizing fun contests and mini-events at the booth over the 5-day show ✅ Requesting [b]USK certification[/b] (mandatory and... let’s just say, [i]financially painful[/i]😅)
✅ Reaching out to publishers, biz devs, streamers, and fellow indies, networking is vital!
✅ And of course… [b]continuing development[/b] to deliver a smoother, better demo![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/f0ef19fbea7b4add711f5cde135df5a43495ff95.png"][/img][/p][p]💌 [b]Stay tuned![/b] After Gamescom (and hopefully with some extra funding on the horizon 🤞), we’ll be back with exciting updates and new features to share. In the meantime, if you’re in Cologne at the end of August, don’t miss the chance to visit us:📍 [b]Hall 10.1 – Booth B26 – Gamescom 2025[/b][/p][p]We’ll be waiting with a playable demo, good chats, and a whole lot of love for simulation games.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support! 💛

[i]Your Mad Pumpkins team[/i]
[i]🎃🎃🎃[/i][/p]

notes.title: Summer & Fall Roadmap Reveal!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Steam community!

We’re beyond excited to share that [i]Movierooms[/i] has just reached [b]2,000 wishlists[/b] and we couldn’t have done it without YOU. Thank you for your support, your feedback, and your passion for building the cinema of your dreams![/p][p]To celebrate this milestone, we’re sharing some exciting news and a sneak peek into what’s coming next. Let’s dive in![/p][h2]
Meet us at Gamescom 2025[/h2][p]That’s right, [i]Movierooms[/i] will have its very own [b]booth at Gamescom[/b]!
If you’re planning to attend, [b]come say hi and meet the dev team in person[/b]. We can’t wait to connect with you, hear your thoughts, and show you some behind-the-scenes work on the game![/p][p][/p][h2]Upcoming Features Roadmap[/h2][p]We want to keep you fully updated on what we’re working on behind the curtains. Here’s what’s next for [i]Movierooms[/i], from now through the fall![/p][h3]Pre-Gamescom Focus:[/h3][list][*][p]🎯 [b]New objective-based tutorial[/b] making onboarding smoother and more dynamic.[/p][/*][*][p]🧩 [b]Modular special missions[/b] for more varied and replayable gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🧽 [b]Polish & bug fixing[/b] based on your feedback from the demo and Next Fest![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Major Features Coming Next (this Summer & Autumn):[/h3][h3]📊 [b]Statistics Page[/b][/h3][p]We’re working on a comprehensive stats panel to help you understand what’s working in your cinema, from item usage to customer behavior.[/p][h3]💸 [b]Detailed Pricing & Stock Management[/b][/h3][p]Set prices for everything: tickets, vending machines, popcorn types, even limited-edition goodies! And manage your stocks to avoid running out during peak hours.[/p][h3]🌱 [b]Tech Tree & Reputation Tokens[/b][/h3][p]Provide great experiences to earn [b]Reputation Tokens[/b] and unlock:[/p][list][*][p]Cheaper/more efficient equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Loyalty cards[/p][/*][*][p]New customization options[/p][/*][*][p]More hiring flexibility
Plus: [b]VIP Tokens[/b] will reward elite management decisions and offer exclusive bonuses![/p][/*][/list][h3]📣 [b]Marketing Tools[/b][/h3][p]Target customer demographics based on movie genres and organize campaigns and special events (e.g., “family weekend” or “sci-fi discount night”) to attract the right audience at the right time.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Bonus Feature… by Popular Demand:[/h2][p][b]Drum roll... Introducing: CAT HIRING! [/b]😸 Back in the 1900s, hygiene was a major issue, so yes, [b]you'll be able to hire a CAT[/b] to chase away mice in your old-school cinema levels. You're welcome, community. [/p][h3]
And More![/h3][list][*][p]New sandbox equipment;[/p][/*][*][p]More animations and 3D content from Chiara;[/p][/*][*][p]Continuous bug fixes and player-requested tweaks. [/p][/*][/list][p]We're so grateful to be on this journey with you. Stay tuned for more updates soon and don’t forget to visit our [b]Steam page[/b] and [b]wishlist if you haven’t yet[/b]! 💛


See you at Gamescom… and in the next update![/p][p]The Mad Pumpkins Team 🎃[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️Steam Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]During this exciting Steam Next Fest, many of you got the chance to try out the free demo of Movierooms… and probably encountered a few bugs along the way! 😅[/p][p]We want to send a huge thank you to everyone who submitted bug reports (available in the Settings menu during your game). Thanks to your help, we were able to fix several issues and upload an improved version. 💪
[/p][p] [u][b]🔧 Here are some of the key fixes:[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p]Some players noticed characters freezing or getting "glitched" near trash bins or toilets. That issue has now been fixed — everything should run smoothly again![/p][/*][*][p][b][i][u]Steam also played a little trick on us: in some cases, it didn’t recognize the executable file. If the demo didn’t launch for you, simply restart Steam, and it should now appear correctly.[/u][/i][/b][/p][p]
 [b][u]🔧 Additional functionalities:[/u][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Add a few daily missions![/p][/*][*][p]Temporary tutorial improvement, pending dynamic non-intrusive one!
[/p][/*][/list][p] [u][b]🎮 A Big Thanks from First Playable![/b][/u][/p][p]We’d also like to thank everyone who visited us at First Playable (the gaming industry event in Florence, Italy), where part of the Movierooms team was present in person.[/p][p]We were honored to receive [b]amazing feedback[/b] on the depth and ambition of the project, your support truly means the world to us![/p][p]Sp, as the French say: lentement mais sûrement 🇫🇷 = Step by step, we’re building something special.[/p][p][/p][p][u][b]We'd Love Your Feedback on the New Home Page[/b][/u][/p][p]With this update, we’d also like to hear your thoughts:[/p][p][i]📌 What do you think of our new home screen concept?[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/39dc33c9fa992e8dc81ea1816e5661dd46b8534e.png"][/img][/p][p]Let us know in the comments or via the in-game feedback options![/p][p]Thanks again for your passion and support, keep playing, testing, and dreaming with us as we build your ultimate cinema tycoon!🍿✨[/p][p]The Mad Pumpkins Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎬 Movierooms Enters Steam Next Fest
Updates and News
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Over the past few weeks, we’ve been focusing on two big things:
🐞 [b]Fixing several bugs[/b] you’ve kindly reported (thank you!)
🌍 [b]Implementing localization in 4 languages[/b]: English, French, Italian, and Portuguese.
NB: as an indie team, we’re doing our best to use our limited budget wisely to deliver a solid Early Access version. That’s why (for now) we’re sticking to the languages we can handle internally within our team.

✨ [u][b]Good news[/b][/u]: the improved demo will be available a few days before Steam Next Fest!
It’s a great opportunity to collect feedback and refine the game even more—we want to meet (or exceed!) your expectations. As a small team working part-time while balancing other jobs to keep this dream alive, we truly appreciate your patience. We’re doing our best, and we’re getting closer!

🗓️ So, [b][u]when’s the launch?[/u][/b] We’d love to stick with our original plan, in July. However, we’ll make a final decision based on how things go during and after the Next Fest. We want to be sure we launch at the right moment.

🎮 In May, [u][b]we’ll focus on[/b][/u]: [list]
[*] Getting the game tested by streamers and content creators,
[*] Polishing the UI,
[*] Fixing everything that needs fixing,
[*] And… 🥁 drumroll, please… implementing the save system! 💾
[/list]

Thanks so much for your continued support—it’s what keeps us going and improving every single day. 💛
Stay tuned… the best is yet to come!
🎃 [i]Mad Pumpkins team[/i] 🎃

notes.title: Open Demo Closing & Exciting Updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The Movierooms Open Demo has now closed for this phase, and we want to send a huge THANK YOU to everyone who took the time to explore both the Historical Mode and Sandbox Mode! And thanks to your incredible support, [u][b]we’ve reached 1,510 wishlists! [/b][/u]🎉 
Many of you have helped us identify and report bugs—something we’re actively working to fix it. ːsteammockingː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/1314e3d74efcb8bba8b58113275be6112fe021d5.png[/img]

📅 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
We’ll be back around late April/early May with another free Sandbox Mode playtest, featuring all the bug fixes from this period. This will be the final test phase before we move toward the full release at [i]Steam Next Fest in June![/i]

But that’s not all… Spoiler for you! Today we would love to share how we’re blending simulation and storytelling in a way that’s rarely seen in the tycoon/management game genre!

[b]Bringing History to Life in Movierooms! ✨Crafting the Story Mode[/b]
Game narratives often evolve alongside development. That’s when the big question arose: “How do we justify time travel in a historical cinema simulation?”
💡 What if famous historical figures ended up in the wrong time periods? With the help of Gaspard, our mascot, players must unravel the mystery and restore cinema history!

[b]🏛️Exploring Cinematic Eras[/b]
Movierooms is more than just a simulation—it’s a journey through film history! As you manage your dream cinema, you’ll:
🎥  Discover real historical facts about the film industry.
🎞️  Explore vintage movie posters from each time period.
📰  Read newspapers with real-world insights on society, trends, and cinema of the time.

🎭[b] Meet Iconic Film Figures[/b]
[i]One of the most exciting parts of Story Mode is the chance to meet legendary film figures. Improving your cinema can attract VIP guests, unlocking special quests inspired by their real lives![/i]

************************************************************
[b]Unique Story-Driven Mechanics Spoiler[/b]
In the demo, you met Salvador Dalí, the Surrealist artist and filmmaker, who dreams of meeting Georges Méliès. Helping him is just the beginning!
More historical characters are coming soon, including Georgette Méliès, daughter of the legendary director, whose contributions to cinema deserve to be recognized.

So, each level introduces game mechanics inspired by real historical challenges. 
📽️ Example: Italy, 1930s – Players must navigate strict censorship laws when screening American films. A government censor is always watching—so be careful if you want to entertain your audience without getting caught!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/306b0a3600167c2224708153ff0b59214cf6f951.png[/img]

[i][b]Also, thank You yet for Your Support! [/b][/i]💙 
Movierooms is not just about managing a cinema—it’s about reliving film history through exciting challenges, legendary characters, and hidden stories waiting to be discovered!
[b][i] Share this update and invite your friends to join the adventure! [/i][/b]
[i]Mad Pumpkins Team[/i]

notes.title: Movierooms DEMO is LIVE until March 16th!
notes.content:
We hope you enjoy building your own movie theater in the Sandbox mode and exploring the first ages of cinema in the Story Mode!

[h3]The DEMO is available until March 16th[/h3]

[h2]About Movierooms[/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44427781/b59a0038e7be214381d0f427253e09fb1af5e1c7.png[/img]

Through space and time, explore the various aspects of handling a thriving business. Manage movie choices and screenings, staff, rooms, and more!

[h2]What makes Movierooms unique?[/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44427781/5a602a17901e68159d4d1b099a1cdc5c51f42dff.png[/img]


From the 1900s until today, choose and program movies, create projection rooms and facilities to make your establishment the finest in town, and create a unique experience for your customers!

[h2]Why is the DEMO available only for two weeks?[/h2]

As we're heading towards the Early Access, we want to make sure that the DEMO reflects the quality and essence of Movierooms, while getting feedback from you!

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44427781/897770b06037571bfbac15d4e407fca040a70998.png[/img]

* Intro Cinematica
* Dynamic tutorial enhancement
* Special mission complete for 2 historical levels
* Statistics page
* Resolution of reported bugs

We have a release date in mind, but we want to keep the suspense for a short time to confirm that we're on schedule. Stay tuned, we'll share more info soon!

Mad Pumpkins team

notes.title: Update on the demo and development updates
notes.content:
Hello Movie lovers !

It’s Marie again and today I am going to talk about the demo available on Steam and what is yet to come!

[h2]Contents of the demo[/h2]

We have made available a demo of the game on Steam for all of our supporters and interested players to play!

For now, you have access to the level set in 1930 that displays some of the available features developed for the game. Here, you will be able to decorate, build projection rooms, toilets, or staff break rooms and choose the equipment and services you want to provide.

We were only able to open a little part of the actual game for the demo for you to play but we have a lot more that is still being completed! We hope this can give you a little window to take a peek into the game we have imagined while keeping in mind that we are actively working on a lot more. Tycoons are not easy to demonstrate with a vertical slice but here are some more information on what is planned or in development! (others details here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/madpumpkins/movierooms?ref=boaod1)

[h2]Historical Levels[/h2]

In the Campaign mode, you will have access to cinemas from all around the world, set in different marking eras. By going through the different levels, you will get the opportunity to take a peek into the technology, movie genres and even consumer habits specific to that time and place!

By playing the levels in order, you will explore gradually the different mechanics of managing a cinema, as technologies and clientele change.

The archive tab will give you a lot of information on all of the captivating historical components. This is possible thanks to our research and our various partnerships with cultural institutions that want to spread knowledge with us.

As we go, we wish to integrate real cinemas that we have partnerships with into the game l, like the Grand Rex in Paris or Cinema Mexico in Italy that have been a continuous support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44427781/45dc635739559409b8816f4e9f0057dc85d931dd.png[/img]

[h2]The Sandbox![/h2]

In the Sandbox mode you will obviously have a lot more creative freedom! Choose among a wide variety of movies, equipment and decor to build your dream cinema. Create a strong identity for your brand by choosing color schemes, logos, uniforms and more to make this Cinema the beginning of a new empire!

You will get the opportunity to unlock more research than ever and enjoy the unique decor and visual variants of your favorite equipment and some spécial rewards unlocked in campaign mode to polish your style.

Play unique challenges to keep on reinventing your business and play in an area fit for a Multiplex!

[previewyoutube=-Gx5jRThpCY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy the demo and that you are excited to uncover more of what we have in store for you!

Thank you for your amazing support!

Marie Legrand, Co Founder Mad Pumpkins
